notes.title: Nowhere Girl: Trainwreck Studios' newest VN!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499125/01813f0a31f7b1c4b10029381a982ee68d20ffb9.png[/img]

A mysterious ghostly woman has been chained to your leg! The only way to get rid of her is to fall in love with her, and not vice versa.

Nowhere Girl is the newest VN from Trainwreck Studios, headed by writer Wilson Taylor and produced with the help of lead artist Emily Suh!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499125/ea4aa5e5ca7b5e07479c9c7e7ada733cc39edb58.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499125/a283e9a88d0582ea7197b7047acef1da48a45517.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27499125/22274d81cdee17421f0bc589c6e24e02ac691e37.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/954150/Nowhere_Girl/]Click here to check out the store page![/url]

Nowhere Girl releases Oct. 30th! See you then!

notes.title: First Patch + Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
We've created the first patch to Animal Lover, fixing a few bugs we didn't know were there the first time around and a couple that we [b]thought we fixed but I guess life has a way blindsiding you when you present yourself [i]to the entire world[/i][/b] but I'm getting ahead of myself, of course! Should all be taken care of! Ha ha ha ha ha!

If you come across any bugs now, PLEASE let us know if you see them and report them! We want you to experience Animal Lover as it was meant to be played!

Here's a few of the things we fixed:

- Frankie's kiss scene no longer switches clothing

- 'Learning The Hard Way' and 'Learning The Easy Way' paths now consistently separate.

- Ren'Py default sprite no longer showing up in that weird spot on Frankie's path

- The diner scene's meal tracking should be fixed now.

Secondly: We have Steam Trading Cards now! 

- 15 Cards!
- 7 Backgrounds!
- 5 Emoticons!
- 6 Badges!

Get out there and collect! Or just trade them away for a small discount on your next Steam game! I mean... I mean that's what I do.
